ns2:course.label: Polymer Physics
ns2:course.description: Techniques and applications of polymer crystal structure and morphology observation; x-ray, electron, light, and neutron scattering and diffraction; light and electron microscopy. Morphology-processing property relationships of crystalline polymers, blends, and copolymers; liquid, plastic, and condis crystals; deformation mechanisms and orientation characterization; relaxations and transitions; crystallization theory. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: MSE 450.
